question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.

Take hold of forcibly or suddenly
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seize**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of one word in place of a wordy phrase to clarify the sentence structure is known as one word substitution. 
 
• The word **Seize **means take hold of abruptly and firmly
 
• *Example *: My luggage was **seized **at airport by mistake.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **liberate **means to set something free.

*Example *: To **liberate **the country, rebels fought.

 
• The word **release **means allow to escape.

*Example *: The prisoners of war were **released **by government.

 
• The word **Relinquish **means voluntarily give up possession or claim

*Example *: She was forced to **relinquish **control of the project.
